summary: Amparai iteration 2 backend regression — 19/19 pytest cases PASSED on the external preview URL. Coverage: onboarding/status (auth guard + shape + steps consent/clinical/circle + total=3), /api/clinico GET seeds default + idempotent (no duplicate insert) + PUT reflects in GET (blood_type='A+', mobility='assistida'), PUT /api/elder {consent_given:true} reflects in onboarding.consent, /api/members list+create (mem_ prefix)+delete, /api/invitations create (8-char UPPER hex code + invite_url ending in /convite/{code}) + PUBLIC GET returns invitation+elder_name + 404 on unknown, /api/whatsapp/nudge URL starts with https://wa.me/ and contains URL-encoded 'quando puder' (case-insensitive, message uses capitalized 'Quando' as sentence start), /api/expenses create (exp_ prefix) + reflection in /api/custos, PUBLIC /api/pulseira/{elder_id} returns elder+blood_type+allergies+conditions+emergency_contacts + 404 on unknown, PUBLIC /api/pulseira/{elder_id}/scan accepts anonymous scans + subsequent authed /scans lists them, /api/sos returns elder_id+elder_name+recent_scans (>=1 after scan), /api/ocr/receipt returns 200 with title/amount/category/date (fallback path executed cleanly for tiny 1x1 PNG), guardrail re-check on /api/summary/weekly (no forbidden voice words). Test data prefixed TEST_ was cleaned up post-run.

minor.issue: Redundant DB call: server.py:475 calls db.elders.find_one and db.invitations.find_one twice to look up owner_id. The earlier `inv` doc already contains owner_id (projected out) — fetch owner_id BEFORE stripping it, or query elders in one call. Cosmetic; no functional impact.
Same pattern: server.py:566 does an extra db.elders.find_one call to get owner_id after already fetching the elder doc (owner_id was projected out). Reuse the first fetch.

Message text starts with 'Quando puder' (capital Q) — review spec asked for URL to contain URL-encoded 'quando puder' (lowercase). Test was adapted to case-insensitive compare. If exact lowercase is required, lowercase the substring in the message template.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: consolidate the two duplicate MongoDB lookups in get_invitation (line 475) and public_pulseira (line 566) to reduce query count from 2 to 1.
Optional: lowercase 'quando puder' in the WhatsApp nudge message if the exact-case spec matters for the deep-link body.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~656 lines with multiple domains (auth, clinical, elder, members, invitations, whatsapp, ocr, expenses, pulseira, sos). Consider splitting into routers (routers/auth.py, routers/clinical.py, routers/circle.py, routers/pulseira.py) once >700 lines.

onboarding_status.steps.circle depends on members count only; the seeded 'shifts' collection already contains Carla/Bruno/Dona Rita as caregivers. If those should count as circle members too, wire it through the members collection (currently members starts empty). Product decision, not a bug.
OCR endpoint gracefully falls back to zero-value stub on any exception — verified 200 response for a tiny 1x1 PNG. Good defensive handling.
public_scan writes owner_id from elder doc into wristband_scans — correct, allows list_scans (auth-gated) to filter safely.
public_pulseira does not require auth by design — verified it does NOT leak elder.owner_id or notes (only name/age/photo, blood_type, allergies, conditions, emergency_contacts). Good.
invitation code is 8-char uppercase hex from uuid4 — collision probability acceptable for MVP but consider retry-on-conflict if scaled.
seed_data_creation: Re-seeded Bearer test_bearer_token_abc / user_test123 in MongoDB before the run (the iter1 logout test had invalidated it). Test-created rows (TEST_Bruno member, TEST_Bruno invitation, TEST_Farmacia expense, TEST_Passante scan) were removed after the run via mongosh cleanup. Elder consent_given flag on Dona Maria was set to true during TestElderUpdate and left as-is (progression state for onboarding).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bearer test_bearer_token_abc is valid post-run (no logout test in iter2). For iter3 you can reuse /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, TEST_BEARER const, api_client + auth_client fixtures). Note the DB state after iter2: elder.consent_given=true, clinical.blood_type=A+ mobility=assistida on user_test123 (set by TestClinical.test_put_reflects_in_get + TestElderUpdate). If iter3 needs the original defaults, run: mongosh amparai_db --eval 'db.clinical.deleteMany({owner_id:"user_test123"}); db.elders.updateOne({owner_id:"user_test123"},{$unset:{consent_given:""}});'. All TEST_-prefixed rows are already cleaned. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is configured — both OCR (gpt-4o) and weekly summary (claude-sonnet-4-5) can succeed live, and both have working fallbacks. The public pulseira & scan endpoints correctly return 404 for unknown elder_ids.
rca_of_issue: N/A — one initial test assertion failure was a spec/casing mismatch (message capitalizes 'Quando'), corrected by making the assertion case-insensitive. No production bugs found.
